calls.title: Impromptu meeting
calls.summary: James Shannon (GrowthBook sales) discussed deployment architecture options (managed warehouse vs. warehouse native) and AI capabilities for experimentation assistance and cost monitoring with Lan Ha (automotive vertical) and Thao Nguyen (real estate vertical). Pain points included per-seat pricing limiting accessibility and the need for open feature support for easy vendor migration. Next steps: James will use the gathered info to strengthen the RFP proposal and will follow up with procurement manager Monica on migration details and pricing.

calls.title: Impromptu meeting
calls.summary: Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook sales) discussed the platform's warehouse-native feature flagging and A/B testing capabilities, addressing Vivek Sadhineni and Anudeep AAsolutions' (both technical leads) pain points around integrating with a custom SDK for targeted user rollouts on a CMS platform, data security, and potential white-label usage. Next steps include Daniel following up on SDK feasibility, setting up a Slack support channel, and arranging a separate partnership discussion.
